# Hello!

I am a speech-language pathologist and PhD candidate in the Department of Speech-Language-Hearing Sciences at the University of Minnesota, where I work under the mentorship of [Dr. Natalie Covington](https://cla.umn.edu/about/directory/profile/nvcoving). 

I am currently working on my dissertation, tentatively titled *Purpose in Life & Well-Being Among Care Partners of Individuals with Traumatic Brain Injury–Related Cognitive-Communication Disorders: A Mixed-Methods Investigation*.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## {{< fa magnifying-glass >}} Research Interests

- Purpose in life and well-being after traumatic brain injury
- Care partner and dyadic adjustment
- Community-engaged rehabilitation
- Scholarship of teaching and learning

------------------------------------------------------------------------
